form.codigo_barras_exemplo: Leave empty to auto-generate an internal SKU
form.imagem_criar_primeiro: To upload a file instead of pasting a link, create the product first and then edit it.
form.peso_ajuda: In the unit chosen above. Leave zero if it does not apply.
form.pesavel_ajuda: If ticked, the POS will ask for the weight or read the scale label. Requires the KG unit.
form.validade_ajuda_depois: on every goods receipt of this product. That is what makes the alerts exist — without it, dates are not recorded and there is nothing to monitor.
form.aviso_dias: How many days in advance to warn?
form.aviso_ajuda: Empty uses 45 days. The useful life of a yoghurt is not that of a tin of preserves.
form.lote_ajuda: Without this, the batch is derived from the expiry date itself — which is already enough to tell goods apart in the warehouse.

validacao.nome_curto: Name must have at least 2 characters
validacao.aviso_minimo: The warning must be at least 1 day
validacao.escolher_armazem: Choose the warehouse this product's stock refers to.
validacao.minimo_zero: The minimum must be greater than zero — below it the product triggers alerts.

stock_inicial.intro: The warehouse and the minimum stock are mandatory: without a minimum, the product does not appear in stock-out alerts or purchase suggestions. The quantity is optional — leave it at zero if the goods have not arrived yet.
stock_inicial.sem_armazens: There are no active warehouses. Create one under Warehouses before receiving stock.
stock_inicial.minimo_ajuda: Below it the product triggers alerts and purchase suggestions.

minimos.erro: Could not load the balances by warehouse. If the server was updated recently, restart it — this section uses a new endpoint.
minimos.vazio: This product has no stock positions. Create a warehouse in the Warehouses section.
minimos.intro: The reorder point is per warehouse. Below it the product triggers alerts and purchase suggestions. Zero means "no minimum set".
minimos.negativo: The minimum stock cannot be negative.

imagem.formatos: JPEG, PNG or WEBP up to 5MB — converted to WebP. Up to 6 images.

fornecedores.intro: A product can have more than one supplier. Purchase suggestions use the lowest cost among them.
fornecedores.custo_invalido: The purchase cost must be a valid number.

lista.pesquisar: Search by name, SKU or barcode...
lista.vazio_pesquisa: No products found for your search.
lista.eliminar_mensagem: Delete "{{nome}}"? If the product has associated stock, sales or purchases, the deletion will be refused — in that case deactivate it instead of deleting it.

categorias.intro: They group products in the catalogue, at the POS and in list filters.
categorias.apagar_mensagem: Delete "{{nome}}"? If there are products in this category the server will refuse — move them first.
categorias.imagem_ajuda: Used on the category button at the POS.
